• ​Mango Shower

 
 
• Towards the end of summer, there are pre-monsoon showers which are common phenomena in Kerala and coastal areas of Karnataka.
 
• Locally, they are known as mango showers since they help in the early ripening of mangoes.
 
 
 
• Nor Westers
 
 
• These are dreaded evening thunderstorms in Bengal and Assam. 
 
• Their notorious nature can be understood from the local nomenclature of ‘Kalbaisakhi’, a calamity of the month of Baisakh.
 
• These showers are useful for tea, jute, and rice cultivation.
 
• In Assam, these storms are known as “Bardoli Chheerha”.
 
 
 
• Loo
 
 
• Hot, dry, and oppressing winds blowing in the Northern plains from Punjab, Uttar Pradesh to Bihar with higher intensity between Delhi and Patna.
